Name: `SLEEP_STATE`
Description: Set default sleep state. Unset to use default (`mem`).

Name: `POWER_NONBOOT_CPU_OFF`
Description: Turn off non-boot CPUs when suspend. Unset to disable.
Notes: No need to set `intel_idle.max_cstate` if using this.

Name: `intel_idle.max_cstate`
Description: Force max cstate level for Intel CPUs. Unset to disable.
Notes: More info can be found on [intel_idle driver document](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/pm/intel_idle.html#kernel-command-line-options-and-module-parameters). Recommend `2` for some Intel Atom SoCs. Does not work on AMD CPUs.
